children: Overview
UK systems support software provider's H1 revenue rose 29% yr/yr to £5.8 mln
Gross profit margin for H1 improved to 54% from 44% last year
Adjusted loss before tax narrowed to £0.3 mln from £2.0 mln loss in H1 2025
Technical Services revenue was weaker due to delayed contract awards, but H2 expected to be stronger
Outlook
Pennant expects 2026 revenue of at least £13.0 mln, in line with market expectations
Company anticipates stronger H2 2026 due to new software launches and contract wins
Order book provides about 80% coverage of analyst revenue forecasts for FY2027
Result Drivers
AUXILIUM SOFTWARE GROWTH - Co said increased licensed users and new customer sales drove higher recurring revenue from Auxilium suite
TRAINING SYSTEMS CONTRACTS - Strong order intake and progress on engineered-to-order programs tripled Training Systems revenue
CONVERTWISE LAUNCH - New technical publication conversion service launched in partnership with OnePoint Consulting, first sale to North American military customer
